WITH s AS (SELECT SUM(ad_spend_eur) spend, COUNT(DISTINCT metric_time__day) sd, MIN(metric_time__day) s_min, MAX(metric_time__day) s_max FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.governed.ad_spend_daily` WHERE campaign__channel='search' AND metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'),
